statements.proposition: This change keeps existing v1 text-format files working exactly as before (reading and writing v1 behaviour is unchanged).
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: Settled by inspecting the full puz.py diff, not by running tests: running the repository's tests in the sandbox was refused by the permission system, so pytest was not run. Every change to an existing code path is gated on v2: in from_text_format the only removed lines ('if REBUS in d: pass # TODO') are replaced by a block under 'if file_version == "v2"', so a v1 file (header 'ACROSS PUZZLE') still ignores REBUS exactly as at base; in to_text_format the new sections are under 'if text_version == "v2"' and the default remains 'v1'. Other additions are new Rebus methods and new private helper functions that no existing path calls. The only other deletion is the trailing 'return' line, re-added identically with a newline. Not verified at runtime.
